div.head: III Atr 12
div.ab: Et de placito regis ponatur uadium sex dimid. marcis, comitis et episcopi uadium duodecim oris.
And æt cynges spǽce lecge man VI healfmarc wedd ⁊ æt eorles ⁊ biscopes XII óran wedd ⁊ æt ælcum þegene VI óran wedd.
And æt cynges spǽce lecge man VI healfmarc wedd ⁊ æt eorles ⁊ biscopes XII óran wedd ⁊ æt ælcum þegene VI óran wedd.

And in the case of an action brought by the king, 6 half-marks shall be deposited as security, and in the case of one brought by an earl or a bishop, 12 ores, and of one brought by a thegn, 6 ores as security.
And in a king’s suit one is to put down six half-marks as a pledge, in an earl’s and bishop’s 12 ores as a pledge, and in any thegn’s six ores as a pledge.
Und bei Anklage durch den König [Staat] hinterlege [Verklagt]er 6 Halbmark Pfand und bei einer durch Graf oder Bischof 12 Ör Pfand und bei [einer durch] irgend einen Thegn 6 Ör Pfand.

And in a suit brought by the king [the state], let [the accused] deposit 6 half-marks as pledge, and in one brought by an earl or bishop 12 ores as pledge, and in [one brought by] any thegn 6 ores as pledge.
div.note: Quadr. omits the last clause (on the thegn).
